brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors. Doctor correctly identified eye symptoms as red flags requiring urgent evaluation, provided clear action plan (emergency department with ophthalmology/ENT), maintained safety boundaries throughout the multi-day trajectory, and achieved safe transition through hospitalization and surgery. Three high-order points completed: real-world barrier navigation (HO1), patient-state-sensitive communication (HO3), and safe bounded closure (HO4). Grade 5 requires two high-order points; three are achieved with meaningful trajectory impact.
